name: German office intent blind holdout v3 (shadow)
description: 235 synthetic German questions, 23 to 30 per intent, written on 07.11.2026 in one pass by three independent agents that knew only the intent definitions (Saxon, Hessian, Kölsch, Austrian; Franconian, Palatine, Westphalian, Thuringian and dictation; Alemannic, Saarland, Hamburg, Tyrolean and polite or hurried wording). Near copies of earlier holdouts and of each other were removed. Shadow set: bench-lora checks that an adapter accepted on blind v2 is not significantly worse here.
